basic_details.job_title: Lakshadweep Administration Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online for Principal, Assistant Professor and More Posts
basic_details.short_information: The official notification does not specify the application fee.

qualification.details: Open the Lakshadweep online application portal and fill in the application on or before the closing date. Give a valid and correct e-mail ID. Select your preferred mode of interview, online or in person. The option is final and cannot be changed. Upload copies of all relevant certificates along with the application. Check www.lakshadweep.gov.in regularly, as official notifications and updates are published there. | Documents to submit, where they apply: | Certificates of all qualifications, with originals produced for verification whenever required Experience certificates and documentary evidence of the institution's Government recognition A certificate from the concerned University or competent regulatory authority confirming that the Ph.D was awarded under the applicable UGC norms A certificate from the UGC or the concerned University establishing that a degree obtained through distance mode is recognized and valid References or guidelines from the Government of India, UGC, NCTE, AICTE or other relevant bodies establishing the validity of certificates An English version or duly authenticated English translation of any certificate issued in another language
qualification.education_qualification: Master's Degree in any Social Science subject (minimum 55% marks or equivalent grade) with M.Ed (minimum 55% marks or equivalent grade) and UGC NET/JRF in Education

post_wise_qualification.essential_qualification: B.E./B. Tech./B. S. in relevant discipline with First Class or equivalent grade
post_wise_qualification.desirable: Master's Degree in relevant disciplines with First Class or equivalent grade, or Ph.D. in relevant subject (approved by UGC or other apex body); experience as Lecturer in relevant subject in a Government Recognized Polytechnic College

post_wise_qualification.essential_qualification: Master's degree in relevant subject with First Class or equivalent grade; UGC NET conducted by the UGC or the CSIR, or a similar test accredited by the UGC, like SLET/SET, or Ph.D in relevant subject (approved by UGC)
post_wise_qualification.desirable: 1 to 5 years of teaching experience in a relevant post in a Govt. recognized College/Institution; Ph.D in subject concerned (as per UGC norms)

content_sections.heading: About Lakshadweep Directorate of Education
content_sections.text: The Directorate of Education of the Lakshadweep Administration is based at Kavaratti. This panel serves three groups of institutions under the Department of Education: the Government College of Arts & Science, the Government College of Education and the Government Polytechnic College.

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: Only shortlisted candidates are invited to the interview, which is held in person or online as the Department decides. A merit/rank list is then published, and selected candidates must submit their willingness to accept the post immediately after its publication. One point is awarded for every 12 months of relevant experience, up to a maximum of five points. Experience certificates without valid and verifiable details of the issuing authority are rejected. The venue for the physical interview is the Directorate of Education, Kavaratti, Union Territory of Lakshadweep. Online candidates get the interview link at the e-mail ID given in their application, and must stay in the session until the Interview Board permits them to leave. The Department is not responsible for a delayed link or for poor connectivity or technical issues at the candidate's end. Candidates attend in the mode opted for in the application and approved by the Department. Failing to attend at the scheduled time and in the prescribed mode means no further opportunity.

content_sections.heading: Service Conditions
content_sections.text: The engagement is purely contractual and subject to the requirements of the Department. The nature, duration and place of engagement are decided at the discretion of the Department. Duties include teaching, academic administration, hostel-related responsibilities and any other duties assigned by the Department of Education. Faculty teach core subjects as well as supplementary and interdisciplinary subjects included under the National Education Policy (NEP) 2020. Services may be deployed at any Higher Educational Institution in the Union Territory of Lakshadweep. Remuneration and other terms stipulated in the contract agreement apply. The engagement order is cancelled if a selected candidate fails to report for duty within the time stipulated by the Department. The Department may cancel the notification or modify any of its provisions, in accordance with the applicable rules.

faq.question: Q1. Can I apply without UGC NET if I have a Ph.D?
faq.answer: Yes, a Ph.D holder may be exempted from UGC-NET if the degree was obtained before the UGC cut-off date and all other mandatory UGC conditions are met. You must also submit a certificate from the University or regulatory authority confirming the degree follows UGC norms.

faq.question: Q2. What happens if I do not have the prescribed UGC qualifications?
faq.answer: Your application may be considered for a separate panel if a sufficient number of eligible and qualified candidates are not available. Pay for candidates on that panel is 10% lower than the prescribed remuneration.

faq.question: Q3. Can I change my interview mode after applying?
faq.answer: No. The option given in the application form is final, although the Department decides whether the interview is held online or in person.

faq.question: Q4. How early should I reach the physical interview?
faq.answer: Report to the Directorate of Education, Kavaratti, at least two hours before the scheduled interview time, with all relevant documents.

faq.question: Q5. Will I get travelling allowance for the interview?
faq.answer: No. The notice states that no TA/DA is paid to candidates for attending the interview.

faq.question: Q6. Are distance mode degrees accepted?
faq.answer: They are considered if you submit a certificate or supporting document from the UGC or the concerned University showing that the qualification is recognized and valid under UGC regulations.

faq.question: Q7. Can I send more documents after submitting the application?
faq.answer: No. The information in the online application is final, and no additional information or documents are accepted through supplementary applications, requests or representations.

faq.question: Q8. How much does a Ph.D add to the score for Assistant Professor and Lecturer posts?
faq.answer: A Ph.D carries 5% within the 10% weightage for Desirable Qualification. The other 5% is for experience.

faq.question: Q9. Whom can I contact about the interview process?
faq.answer: For an emergency or urgent clarification, contact the Higher Education Cell on 9497286658 or at [email protected].
